deployment_scope: local-dev plaintext TCP and HTTP multiplexed on one configured endpoint; default loopback, non-loopback only in an operator-isolated network

run.environment: linux-x64; .NET 10; disposable data directories and loopback sockets

TC-N1-NCP-01.gap: The shared .NET codecs execute the required Tier-1 frame types, but npsd does not expose the conformance suite's general-purpose echo fixture.

TC-N1-NCP-03.gap: The default values and real loopback listener are verified with a collision-free test port; the suite's literal 17433 probe is reserved for an isolated process-level conformance run.

TC-N1-NIP-01.gap: Root and managed signing keys survive restart, but the suite's exact root-key cardinality and POSIX 0600 or Windows owner-only ACL fixture has not run.

TC-N1-NIP-02.gap: Ident signing and verification primitives execute, but npsd's native listener does not yet perform the suite's complete bidirectional peer Ident exchange.

TC-N1-NIP-03.gap: Hosted-agent NIDs and restart continuity execute, but the suite's advertised root node NID process fixture is not case-complete.

TC-N1-NDP-01.note: Active npsd-managed agents emit activation_mode=ephemeral with a bounded heartbeat and persistent monotonic graph_seq. Graceful shutdown emits TTL 0.

TC-N1-NDP-02.note: Portable NDP canonical verification succeeds under the IdentFrame public key and fails after signed capability data is tampered. BYO-key agents are excluded rather than signed by the host root.

TC-N1-NDP-03.gap: Known-target HTTP resolution is integrated, but the paired-peer ResolveFrame plus unknown-target ErrorFrame case is not executed as written.

TC-N1-NDP-04.gap: npsd does not expose the optional GraphFrame topology snapshot capability.

TC-N1-NWP-03.note: The npsd local profile exposes NWP pull as HTTP peek plus explicit durable acknowledgement.

TC-N1-NWP-04.gap: The required sustained 100 QPS for 10 seconds with a 10000-row fixture has not yet been run on the specified 1 vCPU and 1 GB baseline.

TC-N1-NWP-05.disposition: Optional at L1 and deliberately declined by this profile. npsd advertises ephemeral pull with explicit acknowledgement; it does not advertise resident or hybrid push.

TC-N1-OBS-01.gap: No case-complete test proves one structured log entry for each frame direction.

TC-N1-OBS-02.gap: No case-complete test proves every required structured frame-log field and type.

TC-N1-OBS-03.gap: No case-complete test proves equivalent structured frame logs on stdout and file destinations.

explicit_non_claims: Production or public non-loopback plaintext native transport
Resident or hybrid inbox push delivery
QUIC, rekeying, TLS termination, or mTLS admission in npsd
